findings.class: PROPOSAL - shared code the lane may not edit
findings.title: The api_reference undocumented-type batch truncates at the manifest's 8000-completion-token cap for a batch of only 31 types (cap 40), and a length-truncated reply is never retried by design.
findings.detail: authoring_tasks dispatches one section_authoring call per batch of up to _TYPE_BATCH (40) undocumented types (README_CONTRACT row 14, 'the descriptions are authored from the signature evidence, never in one oversized call'). Cells-TS has 31 such types (29 class, 2 enum, of 321 public symbols) - one batch, well under the cap by count. That single call generated exactly 8000 completion tokens over 168 s and was cut off mid-generation (finish_reason == length). core/llm/jobs.py:473-483 treats this as structurally unrepairable - 'a re-ask under the same budget cannot help; the manifest's budget must change' - and raises JobError immediately, which aborts the whole transaction (no content_units, no render, no validation). The raw truncated content is never persisted (by the same design), so the exact cause of the per-type verbosity cannot be inspected directly; what is measured is that this repository's 31-type batch needed more than 8000 completion tokens where the cap and the batch size were evidently sized together for a smaller typical output. Proposed, either clears this repository (the lane cannot land either - both files are outside owned_paths): raise section_authoring's max_output_tokens past 8000, the same shape of fix 7ea433e already applied to source_reconciliation (16000 -> 32000) for an analogous truncation; or lower _TYPE_BATCH below 40 so a batch this repository's types produce fits the existing budget. Alternative rejected: an unmodified re-ask - section_authoring.yaml pins temperature 0.0 and seed 1, so a second draw with no code change reproduces the identical 8000-token truncation; that is why this is a fresh finding and a disposition, not a second draw in this box.
